$comment: Curated art plates — the still that stands for an age or a section on pages that have no film of their own. `film` is a slug in featured.json, `still` an index into that film's stills array, `alt` the plate's own alt text (the still's own alt describes a story beat; a plate is an atmosphere). Chosen by INT2 on 2026-09-06 by reading every still's alt/caption; the reasoning is in INT2-report.md. `hub` (added by lane L3, W4) is the same shape for the Stories hub: the page plate and the five doors. Sources: research/R7-art-candidates.json in RUN-2026-09-06-1700-v2.

before-time.alt: Brahmā looks out over a shoreless ocean at the dawn of a new creation, with no earth left to stand on.

earlier-manvantaras.alt: The fixed point at the top of the sky, every other star circling it without end.

satya-yuga.alt: The serpent Vāsuki wound taut as the churning-rope of the Ocean of Milk.

treta-yuga.alt: The dwarf becomes Trivikrama and towers past the crowd as daylight tears open into stars.

dvapara-yuga.alt: Kṛṣṇa holds the whole hill of Govardhana on the little finger of his left hand.

kali-yuga-scriptural.alt: The stone cracks open like dawn and Śiva comes out of it as the ender of Death.

kali-yuga-history.alt: Three immense chariots roll through Puri as countless hands pull them into the street.

future-manvantaras.alt: A boat rides the flood through the drowning dark, bound to Matsya's golden horn.

cross-yuga.alt: Durgā rides her lion toward the demon army, laughing, and the sound alone shakes their ranks.

cosmology.alt: A pillar of fire with no top either god can see and no base either can reach.

manvantaras.alt: The fish grown to fill the ocean itself, golden and vast, one horn shining on its head.

deities.alt: Light pours from the face of every god and climbs into a single mountain-tall column of fire.

lineages.alt: An unnaturally aged king reaches toward his youngest son, who stands young and straight before him.

stories.alt: The pillar splits and Narasiṃha bursts from the stone — a lion's head upon a man's body.

dharma.alt: In the Viśvarūpa, Kṛṣṇa shows Arjuna time itself.

places.alt: Aruṇācala, the hill at Tiruvaṇṇāmalai, where a myth is given a place on earth.

teachers.alt: At dawn a young archer bows before the clay teacher he made for himself.

beings.alt: Garuḍa rises fully formed from the egg, blazing so bright the gods mistake him for fire.

symbols.alt: Sūrya gives the Syamantaka, the sun-gem that makes eight bhāra of gold a day.

texts.alt: Gaṇeśa breaks off his own tusk and writes on to the last verse of the Mahābhārata.

films.alt: The dwarf becomes Trivikrama and towers past the crowd as daylight tears open into stars.

search.alt: Indrakīla at first light — a vast grey-blue Himalayan massif above the treeline.

timeline.alt: The fixed point at the top of the sky, every other star circling it without end.

(root).alt: The serpent Vāsuki wound taut as the churning-rope of the Ocean of Milk.

great-stories.alt: A figure rising out of a bright sea on an open lotus, attendants either side — the picture a great story leaves behind.

gods.alt: Light drawn out of many faces and gathered into one standing column of fire.

people.alt: A crowded arena in warm light, a garland passing between two people and every face turned to watch.

places.alt: A vast grey-blue Himalayan wall at first light, one figure small on the ridge for scale.

texts.alt: A writing table heaped with loose manuscript leaves, a hand at work in lamplight.

ideas.alt: A single form opening onto a field of stars — the picture the abstract words point at.
